description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission 01238/4/P1 approved 18/03/2019 to allow amendments to the fenestration and increase of roof pitch of the rear extension, and introduction of parapet wall to the approved side and rear extensions for drainage purposes.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of original permission 01238/4/P1 dated 18/03/2019.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (WG/2019/03B received: 28/03/2019. WG/2019/02C received: 29/04/2019. WG/2019/04C received: 07/05/2019.
Drawings approved under 01238/4/P1: WG/2019/01, WG/2019/05, WG/2019/06, WG/2019/07, WG/2019/08, and WG/2019/09 received: 29/01/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used as a gym or other purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 4 Worton Gardens, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
